title: SoftwareFactoryAnalysisResult
description: Structured verdict from the software-factory-analysis skill (CAP-1 intake judgment, CAP-2 solution proposal). Parsed by factory/graph/analysis_graph.py from the claude CLI's --json-schema structured_output.

complete.description: True when the story is clear enough to design a solution from.

in_scope.description: True when the story belongs in this codebase.

reason.description: Required (non-empty) when complete or in_scope is false -- the halt reason surfaced to the human. Empty string when both are true.

proposal.description: Prose solution proposal. Null unless complete and in_scope are both true.

subtasks.description: Ordered concrete implementation steps. Empty unless complete and in_scope are both true.

tests.description: Concrete tests that would verify the solution. Empty unless complete and in_scope are both true.

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions that materially affect the proposal. Empty when nothing is unresolved.
